events.title: Why the Monk and the Misfit Monsters?
events.summary: Most of you already know Journey to the West and its famous band of five: Tang Sanzang and his disciples. The story has been adapted into countless games, among them the stunning Black Myth: Wukong.What fewer people realize is that the master and his disciples were never chosen at random. They were all carefully arranged by the Buddha himself, each with an extraordinary past life. Tang Sanzang was once Golden Cicada, the second disciple of the Tathagata. events.title: A party-based RPG roguelike inspired by Journey to the West.
events.summary: Hi everyone! I’m Simon, the developer behind Monk & The Misfit Monsters, and I’m also the solo developer working on the game. Today, I’d like to share a little story about how this game came to be.You’ve probably heard of Journey to the West before. Tang Sanzang, Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing. We all know their journey to the West. But I found myself becoming more curious about the other side of the story: the little monsters and demons who usually appear only as obstacles along the way.
